object.description: Setup: (a) Bluetooth permissions denied; (b) permissions granted and Bluetooth switched off; (c) a phone without the ANT+ service app. Steps: 1. Open the pairing sheet in cases a and b. 2. Start ANT+ pairing in case c. Expected: Case a shows that Bluetooth permissions are not granted; case b shows that Bluetooth is off; case c shows that the ANT+ service app is missing. No case shows an empty list without a cause. The causes no Bluetooth LE radio, scan error and ANT+ pairing error cannot be induced on a normal phone and are verified by PACE-STS-61.
